caption: The drawing depicts a detailed, side-view illustration of an object shaped like a rooster’s head and neck. The object appears to be crafted from wood, as indicated by the texture and visible grain patterns on the surface, and it is colored in shades of brown and gray. The rooster's comb, wattle, and carved feathers are meticulously rendered, with darker shading emphasizing the contours and lines of the carved details. The eye is round with an orange iris and a black pupil. A metallic ring passes through the rooster's beak, from which two tassels hang. The object has a worn and cracked appearance, suggesting age, especially visible in fine lines and fractures in the material. At the base of the neck, there is a band-like collar, and two leather straps with buckles are attached on the lower part—one on the side and one at the bottom. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery present in the image.
title: Carousel Rooster
